sponsored.t: Requires that gas and electric corporations provide in-person customer service representatives and maintain a publicly accessible outage and emergency tracking website
sponsored.sum: Requires that gas and electric corporations provide in-person customer service representatives and maintain a publicly accessible outage and emergency tracking website.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purpose of the Macedon Center Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc., and the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes
sponsored.sum: Relates to the purpose of the Macedon Center Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association, Inc., and the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

sponsored.t: Designates "The Empire State" as the official state nickname
sponsored.sum: Designates "The Empire State" as the official state nickname.

sponsored.t: Names the red-spotted newt/eastern newt the official amphibian of the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Names the red-spotted newt/eastern newt the official amphibian of the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the statute of limitations for leaving the scene of an accident which resulted in the death of another person
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Pete's law"; provides that a prosecution for a hit-and-run which results in the death of a victim may be commenced at any time.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Jeffrey Alva Beall eligibility to apply for military service credit in the New York state teachers' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Jeffrey Alva Beall eligibility to apply for retroactive military service credit in the New York state teachers' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Christine Hasseler to apply for a recalculation of her retirement benefits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Christine Hasseler to apply for a recalculation of her retirement benefits.

sponsored.t: Permits land bank officers and employees to participate in the New York state and local retirement system
sponsored.sum: Permits land bank officers and employees to participate in the New York state and local retirement system if a resolution is adopted by its board of directors.

sponsored.t: Establishes the veterans' memorials preservation act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the veterans' memorials preservation act.

sponsored.t: Relates to posting of private property
sponsored.sum: Permits owners of private property to post such property to prevent trespass by painting purple markings on trees or markers.

sponsored.t: Makes it a ministerial process to amend a license to carry or possess a firearm
sponsored.sum: Authorizes amendments to a license to carry or possess a firearm to be made by the filing officers or county clerk of each county, unless otherwise specified through resolution of the county's legislative body.

sponsored.t: Exempts receipts from the services provided by a farrier in shoeing a horse
sponsored.sum: Exempts receipts from the services provided by a farrier in shoeing a horse including reasonable fees for travel and shoeing a horse in a remote location on a farm.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the born alive abortion survivors' protection act
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the born alive abortion survivors' protection act that places requirements on health care practitioners present at the time a child is born alive during an abortion.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of assault on a pregnant person
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of assault on a pregnant person in the second degree as a class D felony and assault on a pregnant person in the first degree as a class C felony.

sponsored.t: Designates sweet corn as the state vegetable
sponsored.sum: Designates sweet corn as the state vegetable.

sponsored.t: Provides for payment of state aid on account of state lands in the counties of Cayuga, Seneca and Wayne comprising the northern Montezuma wildlife management area
sponsored.sum: Directs state aid to be payable to any municipal corporation or special district that contains land in the counties of Cayuga, Seneca and Wayne comprising the northern Montezuma wildlife management area.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain youths program volunteers from civil liability
sponsored.sum: Exempts volunteers in recreational activities, including but not limited to, little league coaches, managers, assistants and members of the board of directors from civil liability while providing services or rendering assistance to a player or participant as a result of such volunteer's acts of commission or omission arising out of or in the course of rendering such services or assistance during competitive games and practices.

sponsored.t: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine
sponsored.sum: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine on bodies of freshwater located within the state and within the jurisdiction and control of the state.

sponsored.t: Grants excused leave to civil service employees who are volunteer firefighters or ambulance workers during state of emergency
sponsored.sum: Grants excused leave to civil service employees during states of emergency as declared by the federal, state or a municipal government, when such employees are members of a volunteer fire department or a volunteer ambulance or rescue squad.

sponsored.t: Relates to noncommercial aviation
sponsored.sum: Provides that there is no duty to keep premises safe for persons engaging in noncommercial aviation.

sponsored.t: Relates to youth programs sponsored by fire departments
sponsored.sum: Relates to youth programs sponsored by fire departments; provides that participants may respond to an emergency or hazardous activity, but shall remain in a designated or marked off area that has been set up by the chief or officer in charge; provides such participant cannot respond to an emergency on a vehicle using lights and/or sirens; provides such participants may not enter a burning structure.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Come Home to Hunt Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the Come Home to Hunt Act, which provides for the purchase of a two-day hunting license for non-residents to hunt domestic game bird, migratory game bird, big game, and small game.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "New York's Own combat veterans healthcare choice program act" to establish tax free savings accounts to pay the healthcare costs of certain combat veterans until covered by the federal government
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York's Own combat veterans healthcare choice program act" to establish tax free savings accounts to pay the healthcare costs of combat veterans on active duty during Operation Enduring Freedom or Operation Iraqi Freedom, until covered by the federal government; directs the division of military and naval affairs to establish a registry of Afghanistan and Iraq veterans.

sponsored.t: Establishes a presumption of shared parenting of minor children in matrimonial and family court proceedings
sponsored.sum: Establishes a presumption of shared parenting of minor children in matrimonial and family court proceedings.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Sodus Point, in the town of Sodus, county of Wayne to allow golf carts on certain streets
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Sodus Point, in the town of Sodus, county of Wayne to allow golf carts on certain streets under the exclusive control and jurisdiction of such village.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to conduct a study on opening three new veterans nursing homes in New York state and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to conduct a study on opening three new veterans nursing homes in New York state; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the health care worker peer support program
sponsored.sum: Enacts the health care worker peer support program.

sponsored.t: Authorizes distinctive license plates for female veterans
sponsored.sum: Authorizes distinctive license plates for female veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a green alert system for missing military members
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a green alert system for missing military members.

sponsored.t: Exempts from sales and use taxes motor vehicles and rolling stock used by common carriers
sponsored.sum: Exempts from sales and use taxes certain motor vehicles, parts and services therefor and railroad rolling stock, parts and services therefor.

sponsored.t: Permits the use of ATVs on certain roadways in the county of Wayne
sponsored.sum: Permits the use of ATVs on state route one hundred four between the western county line of Wayne county and the northern town line of the town of Hannibal in the county of Oswego.

sponsored.t: Makes seed purchased to grow food for personal consumption exempt from sales and use taxes
sponsored.sum: Makes seed purchased to grow food for personal consumption exempt from sales and use taxes.

sponsored.t: Sets forth notification requirements on abortions performed on minors
sponsored.sum: Requires parental notice prior to the performance of an abortion upon an unemancipated minor; defines unemancipated minor as person less than eighteen years of age; allows for waiver of such notice in limited instances; establishes circumstances and procedures for proceedings to obtain an order waiving such parental notification.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Heath A. Wadhams, a part-time police officer, with the village of Palmyra police department to take the civil service examination
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Heath A. Wadhams, a part-time police officer, with the village of Warsaw police department to take the civil service examination and be eligible for appointment as a full time police officer for the village of Palmyra, in the county of Wayne.

sponsored.t: Relates to sales and compensating sales taxes in the county of Wayne
sponsored.sum: Extends the additional one percent sales and compensating use taxes in the county of Wayne.
